item.title: LPG Crisis Live: Modi Govt to release 20 percent commercial LPG from today; more hotels and restaurants in Bengaluru, Kolkata, Delhi affected
item.description: The Maharashtra government has asked oil marketing companies to promptly fix technical issues affecting LPG booking apps and missed-call services. Officials said the glitches have been creating difficulties for consumers trying to book cooking gas cylinders. The authorities emphasized that restoring these systems at the earliest is crucial to ensure smooth distribution and avoid confusion among households.

item.title: Kerosene is BACK! Old cooking option AVAILABLE at ration shops amid gas cylinder shortage
item.description: Kerosene oil, an old cooking fuel, will be made available through ration shops for cooking and lighting purposes.

item.title: Near death experience! Cabin video shows moments of Hyderabad-Phuket flight that bounces on runway after malfunction
item.description: A Hyderabad–Phuket flight made a terrifying hard landing after a nose-wheel malfunction, leaving passengers panicked. A viral video captured the shocking moment as the aircraft bounced violently on the runway.

item.title: CISCE ICSE, ISC board exams 2026 Cancelled: ICSE Class 10th, ISC Class 12th exam cancelled in UAE amid Iran war
item.description: The board cancelled the Class 10 (ICSE) and Class 12 (ISC) board exams for all centres in the UAE

item.title: Who is Shantanu Narayen? Satya Nadella’s special message for Indian-origin CEO quitting Adobe after 18 years
item.description: Indian-origin tech leader Shantanu Narayen will step down as Adobe CEO after 18 years. Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella praised his leadership, calling it a legendary run that transformed Adobe globally.

item.title: After breaking down, Sunidhi Chauhan postpones her Kolkata concert due to….
item.description: Singer Sunidhi Chauhan has delayed her Kolkata concert after suffering from a severe throat infection. The artist shared an emotional update with fans, explaining that the decision was difficult but necessary.

item.title: IPL 2026: Star India cricketer makes HUGE statement about CSK’s MS Dhoni, says ‘might be last time…’
item.description: Former CSK captain MS Dhoni could be playing in his final season as the IPL 2026 gets underway from March 28 onwards.

item.title: Tinder rolls out AI-powered video speed dating feature in fresh push to reconnect with Gen Z users
item.description: Tinder introduces AI-powered matchmaking and video speed dating to reconnect with Gen Z users. The new features aim to reduce swipe fatigue and encourage authentic connections through smarter technology and real-time interaction.

item.description: Dhurandhar 2 is set to become the first Indian film to gross over Rs 30 crore from its premiere shows in India, seeing by the current pace and tremendous momentum.
